notes: Windows update channels for App Installer (.appinstaller) and winget. Nothing here publishes anything: the files are generated as workflow artifacts, and a channel reaches users only when its files are uploaded to the locations below by a publication step that does not exist yet.

developer is the only identity CI builds today (package-identity.json). Its App Installer file is a preview: it points at a release asset that is never created, so it documents the shape without offering updates.

alpha and stable reserve the Windows identities of the release trains in Docs/alpha-stable-release-trains.md. commissioned stays false until the owner adds a Windows surface to the release-train manifest; building them also needs train-specific data directories in the app (every Windows build uses %LOCALAPPDATA%\JustSpeakToIt today). Stable publication is never automatic: only the owner's Publish Stable run may upload the stable channel's files.

feedBase is the GitHub Releases base. Stable's App Installer file lives at feedBase/latest/download/<file>, which only the Stable GitHub Latest release answers; Alpha is never GitHub Latest, so its App Installer file needs its own mutable URL (the WINDOWS_ALPHA_APPINSTALLER_URL variable), as the Mac Alpha appcast resolves the alpha-latest pointer. Package files are immutable versioned release assets.
WINDOWS_UPDATE_FEED_BASE overrides feedBase for forks and staging.

winget.shortDescription: Dictation and transcription with your choice of speech models.
